variant_answers.phrase: The date is valid if all of the following rules are satisfied
variant_answers.text: The four rules are necessary but not sufficient: the date must also be a real calendar date (for example February 29 only in a leap year, and no year 0000), so '02-29-2001' is invalid.
February allows day 29 only in a leap year (days 1 to 28 otherwise), so '02-29-2001' is invalid and '02-29-2000' is valid.
The month field may be any text that parses as an integer (one digit, three digits, leading '+' or spaces), so '3-11-2000' is valid.
The day field may be any text that parses as an integer, so '03-5-2000' is valid.
The year field may be any text that parses as an integer, so '03-11-20' is valid.

variant_answers.phrase: The date should be in the format: mm-dd-yyyy
variant_answers.text: Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored, so ' 03-11-2000 ' is valid.
